title: Patient Financial Account — Card-on-File Charge Caps by In-Person Visit Type
content:
The cap on a card-on-file charge on the Patient Financial Account depends on the visit type of the appointment that carries the encounter's encounter number, as the patient's In-Person Appointments records show it.

| Visit type of the In-Person Appointments record carrying the encounter | Cap on the card-on-file charge (USD) |
|---|---|
| Advanced Imaging Appointment | 1000.00 |
| In-Office Procedure Visit | 1000.00 |
| Specialist Consultation | 900.00 |
| any other visit type | no different cap under this schedule |

**Notes.**

1. The visit type is found by matching the encounter number of the lines being charged to the In-Person Appointments record that carries that encounter number.
2. The cap is a ceiling on the amount charged: a chargeable amount below the cap is not raised to it.
3. Hypothetical: a chargeable amount of 960.00 on an In-Office Procedure Visit is under the 1000.00 cap and stays 960.00; the same amount on a Specialist Consultation is capped at 900.00.
